þæs: þæt — for that, of that (genitive singular of the demonstrative: 'comfort for that') · se — of the (genitive singular neuter article, before a noun: þæs recedes 'of the hall') · þes — this (demonstrative, nominative singular masculine; the manuscript's þæs for þes, in þæs sele 'this hall') · þæs — so, to that degree (genitive singular of the demonstrative used adverbially; þæs fæste 'so firmly') · þæs — of this (genitive, as object of wēndon: Þæs ne wēndon 'did not expect this') · þæs — as, according as (genitive singular of the demonstrative, with the relative particle: þæs þe 'in so far as, as')
þæt: þæt — that (conjunction; also neuter demonstrative 'that') · þæt — which (neuter relative pronoun, accusative singular, object of wæg; þæt hē on byrnan wæg 'which he bore on the mail-shirt')
þā: þā — then (adverb); also: those, the (plural demonstrative); who, which (relative) · when (conjunction) · þā — the (accusative singular feminine of the demonstrative before a noun)
þām: sē/þæt — them, those; that (dative of the demonstrative) · sē — the (dative singular masculine, before a noun; wið þām āglǣcan 'against the awesome one') · sē — to whom (dative singular masculine of the demonstrative used as a relative; þām … wearð 'to whom … became')
þē: þe — which, that (relative particle; Klaeber prints þē, emended — the MS has only 'þ') · þū — you (dative singular: to you, with you) · þū — you (accusative singular; þæt ic þē sōhte 'that I should seek you') · sē — the, by that (instrumental singular of the demonstrative, before a comparative; þē geornor 'the more clearly') · þū — you, yourself (reflexive dative; þū þē self 'you yourself') · þe — when, after (relative particle, if þē is taken as the sense of the clause requires; þē se āglǣca ... gewand 'when the awesome one ... turned', where several editors print þā; a guess) · þe — because (conjunction, the relative particle; þē hē ūsic gārwīgend gōde tealde 'because he counted us good spear-warriors')
þēoden: þēoden — lord, chief of a people (accusative singular; from þēod 'people') · þēoden — lord (vocative singular) · þēoden — lord, prince (masculine, nominative singular)
þīoden: þēoden — lord, prince, king (masculine, nominative singular, in apposition to gūðkyning; Wedera þīoden 'lord of the Weders'; spelled þīoden)
þū: þū — you (2nd person singular pronoun; cf. 'thou')
þǣr: þǣr — there (adverb) · þǣr — where (relative adverb; þǣr ic fīfe geband 'where I bound five') · þǣr — if, provided that (conjunction; þǣr hē meahte swā 'if he could so')
ānne: ān — one (numeral, accusative singular masculine, with partitive æþelinga; ānne æþelinga 'one of the princes'; cf. 'one') · ān — one, a single (adjective, strong accusative singular masculine, agreeing with its noun; ðone ānne dæg 'that one day', eorðsele ānne 'a single earth-hall')
ār: ār — messenger, herald (nominative singular; Hrōðgāres ār ond ombiht 'Hrothgar's herald and officer')
ēaðe: ēaþe — easy (adjective, nominative plural; also the adverb 'easily')
īren: īren — iron; by extension sword (neuter, nominative singular; cf. 'iron') · īren — iron, sword (neuter, accusative singular, in apposition to sweord)
ǣnig: ǣnig — any (adjective, nominative singular masculine; cf. 'any')
ǣr: ǣr — before, previously (adverb; cf. archaic 'ere') · ǣr — before (conjunction; ǣr gē 'before you') · ǣr — sooner, earlier (adverb, with a comparative sense; nō þȳ ǣr 'none the sooner') · ǣr — before (preposition with dative; ǣr dēaþe 'before death')
